<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

class Test {
public:
    int R, C;
    long long ch[61][61];
    int cntA[61], cntB[61];
    long long best;
    string str;

    struct Key {
        long long x;
        int v1, v2;
        bool operator==(const Key& other) const {
            return x == other.x && v1 == other.v1 && v2 == other.v2;
        }
    };

    struct KeyHash {
        size_t operator()(const Key& k) const {
            size_t h1 = hash<long long>()(k.x);
            size_t h2 = hash<int>()(k.v1);
            size_t h3 = hash<int>()(k.v2);
            return h1 ^ (h2 << 1) ^ (h3 << 2);
        }
    };

    unordered_map<Key, long long, KeyHash> cache;

    class FastReader {
    public:
        istringstream iss;
        string line;
        FastReader() {}
        string next() {
            while (iss.fail() || iss.eof()) {
                if (!getline(cin, line)) return "";
                iss.clear();
                iss.str(line);
            }
            string token;
            iss >> token;
            return token;
        }
        int nextInt() {
            string s = next();
            return stoi(s);
        }
        long long nextLong() {
            string s = next();
            return stoll(s);
        }
    };

    FastReader fr;

    int readInt() { return fr.nextInt(); }
    long long readLong() { return fr.nextLong(); }
    string readString() { return fr.next(); }

    long long cacheGet(long long x, int v1, int v2) {
        Key k = {x, v1, v2};
        auto it = cache.find(k);
        if (it != cache.end()) return it->second;
        return -1; // sentinel, but we need to distinguish from valid 0
    }

    void cachePut(long long x, int v1, int v2, long long val) {
        Key k = {x, v1, v2};
        cache[k] = val;
    }

    void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long diff = llabs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
            if (diff < best) best = diff;
            return;
        }
        if (v1 >= R) {
            long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v2][R];
            dfs(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= R) {
            long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v1][R];
            dfs(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long diff = llabs(x - y);
        if (diff - ch[v1][R] * ch[v2][R] > best) return 0;
        long long cached = cacheGet(x, v1, v2);
        if (cached != -1) return cached;
        if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
            if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
                int sum = v1 + v2;
                v1 -= cntA[sum];
                v2 -= cntB[sum];
                return ch[v1 + v2][v1];
            }
            return 0;
        }
        long long ans = 0;
        char c = str.at(v1 + v2 - 1);
        if (c != 'B') {
            long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v2][R];
            ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (c != 'A') {
            long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
            long long other = ch[v1][R];
            ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        cachePut(x, v1, v2, ans);
        return ans;
    }

    void start() {
        R = readInt();
        C = readInt();
        int maxN = 2 * (R + C);
        vector<vector<long long>> rows;
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; i++) {
            vector<long long> row(i + 1, 0);
            row[0] = row[i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                row[j] = rows[i - 1][j - 1] + rows[i - 1][j];
            }
            rows.push_back(row);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                ch[i][j] = rows[i][j];
            }
        }
        long long x = 0, y = 0;
        int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
        while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R) {
            if (x > y) {
                long long cur = ch[v1][R] - ch[v1 - 1][R];
                long long other = ch[v2][R];
                y += cur * other;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long long cur = ch[v2][R] - ch[v2 - 1][R];
                long long other = ch[v1][R];
                x += cur * other;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        best = llabs(x - y);
        dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        str = readString();
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); i++) {
            cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (str[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (str[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        long long ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        cout << ans << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    Test te;
    te.start();
    return 0;
}
